stem.text: In an experiment, fluorescent dyes were used to label proteins on the outer surface of cell surface membranes. Living human cells were labelled with one colour of fluorescent dye and mouse cells with a different colour of fluorescent dye.
A human cell and a mouse cell are then fused to form a hybrid cell.
At first, the different fluorescent labels remain separate, but after 40 minutes they are distributed randomly across the hybrid cell surface membrane.

A.text: Proteins are found only on the outer surface of cell surface membranes.

B.text: Proteins in the outer layer of a bilayer do not penetrate into the inner layer.

C.text: Proteins move freely in the phospholipids of a bilayer.

D.text: The cell surface membranes of the two cells are bilayers.
